brief: Goldman Sachs Europe equity sales note dated 3 Sep 2026, mostly market reporting with house calls attached. Wednesday's US session: rates relief plus stabilizing momentum, so small caps led, SPX +46bps to 7666, NDX +23bps to 29,143, RTY +113bps to 2953. Europe closed lower a third session, with autos and cyclicals hit by the energy and rates squeeze on consumer discretionary. Cross-asset stance is tactically neutral for 3m and modestly pro-risk for 12m, OW equities, N bonds, commodities and cash, UW credit, because rates volatility, seasonal weakness, US midterms and geopolitics could lift near-term volatility, so stay invested, buy dips and hedge selectively. The French Domestic basket is recommended as an election-noise hedge because 50% domestic sales exposure versus 15% for the CAC 40 makes it the most political-risk-sensitive slice. On oil, AIS-off tanker crossings near Oman explain a 5mb/d upward revision, putting Persian Gulf exports at 15-16mb/d against 10mb/d visible. Broadcom reported in-line revenue, AI semi revenue +221% YoY, guidance just below the Street, target raised to $540. Buy ratings with raised targets on Auto1, PPC and Ferrari.
